method: Four authorized synthetic prompts in the Codex in-app browser. CDP Network.enable succeeded before sending each prompt. Request text was verified from observed POST bodies. Live identifiers were compared in memory with the same conversation's history after reload.
privacy: Only booleans, field paths and synthetic markers are retained. No provider IDs, authentication data, private conversation content or authenticated response bodies are retained in this artifact.

response_identity.live_field: delta message.id where author.role=assistant and channel=final

response_identity.history_field: hNvQHb turn[3][3] selected candidate and matching turn[3][0][] candidate[0]

limitations: One ordinary synthetic generation per provider. This establishes the observed field equalities, not all retry, edit, image, tool, branch or handoff modes.

Some browser event buffers reported truncation during reload; successful comparisons used individually retrieved response bodies for the exact synthetic conversations. No complete network-capture claim is made.
Claude and Perplexity completed streams were recovered from CDP buffered stream content. ChatGPT and Gemini used completed response-body retrieval.
Perplexity performed search despite the synthetic prompt requesting no search; entry timing remains workflow timing.
This was provider protocol inspection in the in-app browser. Native Chrome, Edge and Firefox extension installation, capture overhead and lifecycle release checks remain pending.
